The profile page now has an Account activity card and a Download my data button. I haven't run any tests, lint or the app, as you asked. The new route and its test are untested, and the UI is unchecked in the app.

**What it does**
- The card sits between Personal information and Security on `apps/web/app/(app)/account/settings/profile/page.tsx`. It shows "Account created" and "Last login", formatted with the user's own locale. If there is no recorded login, it shows "No login recorded".
- The button calls a new session-only endpoint, `GET /api/v3/account/data-export`. That endpoint returns the user's name, email, locale, notification settings and organization memberships (organization name and role). The browser then saves the response as `formbricks-account-data.json`.
- I used a v3 route instead of a server action because `apps/web/AGENTS.md` says new server actions are legacy. The button uses a TanStack Query mutation. It mounts its own `QueryClientProvider`, since the profile page doesn't have one.
- The export reads only the signed-in user's own row, and API keys are not accepted. It leaves out pending invitations, meaning memberships with `accepted: false`, so only accepted memberships are exported.

**Files**
- Route code is under `apps/web/app/api/v3/account/`, with a unit test in `lib/operations.test.ts`.
- UI code is in `AccountActivity.tsx`, `DownloadMyDataButton.tsx` and `lib/download-account-data.ts`, in the existing profile settings folder.
- The v3 spec has a new path file, `docs/api-v3-reference/src/paths/api_v3_account_data-export.yml`, and a new schema file, `AccountDataExport.yml`. Both are registered in `docs/api-v3-reference/src/openapi.yml`.
- English strings are added to `apps/web/locales/en-US.json`.

**Still to do on your side**
- Run `pnpm api:v3:sync`. I couldn't run the bundle step here, so the committed `docs/api-v3-reference/openapi.yml` is stale until you do. `pnpm lint` will fail the freshness check until then.
- Run `pnpm i18n` to generate the other locales from the new en-US keys.
- I didn't add the endpoint to the generated-schema list in `packages/api-v3-schemas/scripts/adopted.ts`. The route has no request body or parameters, so I judged it didn't need generated request schemas.
